Pride and Progress News-highlights: 1. Gay Week in Review, with Andy Humm, Jim Levin, Joyce Hunter and special guest Harvey Fierstein, sponsored by the Human Rights Campaign Fund 2.Discussion about Senator Jesse Helms who attacked educational comics from the Gay Men's Heatlh Crisis COMMERCIAL: San Francisco AIDS Foundation 3.Discussion about Randy Shilts book, "And the Band Played On" COMMERCIAL:Human Rights Campaign Fund 4.Discussion about PBS's show, "AIDS Changing the Rules" hosted by President Regan's son, Ronald Regan Jr. 5.News Watch, Provincton, MA town crier has been asked to resign because of homophobic remarks 6.AIDS Drugs Assistance program 7.David Engel, actor in "La Cage Aux Follies" sues Worthington's photography company for not including him and his partner Eric Underwood in their alumni memory book 8.Gay Community Calendar, announcements about upcoming events 9.GCN Sports, Front Runners Benefit Run, Announcements about Pool matches, Gay Indoor Soccer League, Gynmist,Tim Daggett, broke his leg 10.Lavender Health, Interview with Michael Shernoff from Chelsea Psychotherapy Associates 11.Closing Credits
The Right Stuff: 1.Show Bitz, Interview with Will Sheffer from the play, "Fortune in Men's Eyes" COMMERCIAL:The Monster 2."Short Bits of Wisdom From Daddy" by Perry Brass 3.Interview with Bill Kunkel from Village Pointe Condos COMMERCIAL:San Francisco AIDS Foundation 4.Part 2 of Rosa von Praunheim's interview with Craig Russell from the film, "Too Outrageous" COMMERCIAL:Gay Treasures 5.Closing Credits
